title: Christmas gifts for your girlfriend 2026: 12 she'll love (UK)
seoTitle: Gifts for Girlfriend Christmas 2026 UK: 12 Ideas
description: Christmas gifts for your girlfriend in 2026 at UK Black Friday prices: Dyson Supersonic £199, Oura Ring 5 £299, Kindle £119.99 and more.
intro:
**Our best Christmas gift for a girlfriend this year is the Dyson Supersonic hair dryer at £199, £100 off at Amazon. Best cheap pick: Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs at £15.95, a record low. Best splurge: the Oura Ring 5 at £299, also its lowest price yet.**

Every price below was published on 21 or 22 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (to 30 November), so check the product page before you buy. Some prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

deals.name: Dyson Supersonic hair dryer
deals.note: Our best overall: the hair dryer people want but rarely buy for themselves. Quick, quiet and gentler on hair than cheap dryers. £100 off at Amazon (T3, 21 November).

deals.name: Oura Ring 5
deals.note: Our best splurge: a smart ring that tracks sleep, recovery and cycles without a screen on her wrist. £100 off in every finish, a record low per TechRadar. You'll need her ring size (Oura sends a sizing kit), and the full app needs a monthly membership.

deals.name: Apple AirPods 5 with wireless charging case
deals.note: For an iPhone owner whose old earbuds are on their last legs. EE has them for £99, but only for signed-in EE customers. More in our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sonos Ace noise-cancelling headphones
deals.note: Soft, comfortable over-ears with good noise cancelling for the commute, in a choice of muted colours. £150 off (TechRadar, 22 November).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (2026)
deals.note: For a reader with a groaning bookshelf. Light enough for bed and the bath-side, with a glare-free screen. A record low per TechRadar. Add a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) so it's full of books on Christmas Day.

deals.name: Fujifilm X Half compact camera
deals.note: A pocket digital camera that shoots in portrait format with film-style looks, for someone who loves photos but is bored of their phone's. £120 off.

deals.name: Sage The Bambino Plus espresso machine
deals.note: For the coffee lover: café-style flat whites at home, with automatic milk steaming so there's little to learn. Not a record low, but the best price for a couple of years per TechRadar.

deals.name: Suri Pro sonic electric toothbrush
deals.note: A stylish, refillable toothbrush with plant-based heads and a travel case, about 20% off. A thoughtful practical gift for someone who travels a lot.

deals.name: Amazon Echo Spot
deals.note: A neat bedside alarm clock and speaker: sunrise-style alarms, the weather and music by voice. Within £10 of its record low, per TechRadar.

deals.name: Lego Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A cosy evening build you can do together, then put out every Christmas. 20% off. More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sennheiser CX 80U wired earbuds (white/pink)
deals.note: USB-C wired earbuds that never need charging, for a phone without a headphone socket. A tidy stocking filler; this price is for the white/pink pair (black is a little cheaper).

deals.name: Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs
deals.note: Our best cheap pick: soft, reusable ear plugs for sleeping, flights or a noisy office, and a record low per TechRadar. More cheap ideas in our [Christmas gifts under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-under-20-uk/).

body:
## Best Christmas gifts for your girlfriend at a glance

- **Best overall:** Dyson Supersonic hair dryer, £199 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs, £15.95 at Amazon
- **Best splurge:** Oura Ring 5, £299 at Amazon
- **Best for readers:** Kindle (2026), £119.99 at Amazon
- **Best for music lovers:** Sonos Ace headphones, £199 at Amazon

## How to choose a gift she'll actually use

The safest gifts are upgrades to things she already uses every day. If her hair dryer is loud and slow, a Dyson Supersonic is a daily treat. If she reads on her phone at night, a Kindle is kinder on her eyes. If her earbuds are battered, new AirPods or the Sonos Ace will get used on every commute. Pay attention to what she complains about, or what she has bookmarked but never bought, and you're halfway there.

Gadgets with ongoing costs need a little more thought. The Oura Ring is a great present for anyone into fitness or sleep, but the full app needs a monthly membership after the trial, and you'll need her ring size. A sneaky way to get it is to borrow a ring she wears on the finger she'd use. If you're not sure, the Echo Spot, Kindle and headphones all work out of the box.

For a more personal touch, pair a practical present with something small: a Kindle with a Kindle Unlimited trial, a camera with a photo book voucher, or the Lego gingerbread house as a cosy evening activity. If she listens to audiobooks or podcasts on her commute, an [Audible free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/audible/mlp) is a nice extra that costs you nothing.

Perfume and beauty sets are always popular too. We've rounded up dated prices in our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) and our [Christmas gifts for her under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/). For budget-free ideas, try [gifts for women who have everything](/guides/gifts-for-women-who-have-everything-uk/).

## What's a good price this Christmas?

Based on this year's Black Friday prices, these are the figures worth paying:

- **Dyson Supersonic:** around £199 is a strong price; it often sits nearer £300.
- **Oura Ring 5:** £299 is its lowest price so far.
- **Kindle (2026):** £119.99 is a record low; expect it to go back to about £150 after Cyber Monday.
- **AirPods with wireless charging:** under £120 is good; £99 is the best we've seen, at EE.
- **Sonos Ace:** under £200 is a big cut from £349.

Most of these prices are part of Amazon's Black Friday Week, which ends on Cyber Monday, 30 November. Prices usually creep back up in December, so if you've decided, buying before 1 December is the safest bet. Check dates in our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## FAQs

### How much should I spend on my girlfriend for Christmas?

There's no right amount. A gift she'll use every day at £30 beats an expensive one that sits in a drawer. Most of the picks here are between £25 and £200, with a couple of splurges for long-term relationships.

### What can I get my girlfriend who has everything?

Go for an upgrade of something she uses daily (headphones, a hair dryer, a toothbrush) or an experience you can share, like a Lego build or a coffee machine for slow weekend mornings.

### Do I need Amazon Prime for these prices?

Some Black Friday prices are for Prime members only. A [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the sale and gives you free fast delivery, which helps if you leave it late.

### Will these gifts be cheaper after Christmas?

Some will drop again in the Boxing Day sales, but by then it's too late for Christmas morning. If you'd like to wait for your own shopping, see our [Boxing Day sales guide](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/).

Shopping for him too? See our [Christmas gifts for your boyfriend](/guides/gifts-for-boyfriend-christmas-2026/).
